# FreshContext

> Context integrity infrastructure for AI systems and agents.

Canonical: https://freshcontext.dev/
Integration: https://freshcontext.dev/integration
Services: https://freshcontext.dev/services
Sample assessment: https://freshcontext.dev/sample-assessment
Commercial application: https://freshcontext.dev/apply
RAG: https://freshcontext.dev/for-rag
Agents: https://freshcontext.dev/for-agents
Governance: https://freshcontext.dev/for-governance
Demo: https://freshcontext.dev/context-integrity-demo
Specification: https://freshcontext.dev/spec
Repository: https://github.com/PrinceGabriel-lgtm/freshcontext-mcp
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/freshcontext-mcp

FreshContext evaluates candidate context before model or agent use. It scores context-integrity signals such as freshness, source/date confidence, utility and provenance, then returns a reasoned decision about whether context should be used, verified, refreshed, treated as background, watched or excluded.

FreshContext does not certify truth. It does not replace legal, compliance, model-risk, security or organizational governance.

The public FreshContext implementation and specification include MIT-licensed material. Current commercial work focuses on integration, implementation, operation, verification infrastructure and strategic deployment.
